As our first dedicated Senior Finance & FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build.

 

Your Tasks

  • Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic.

  • Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds.

  • Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early.

  • IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials.

  • Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions.

  • Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable.

  • Operational Finance: Own accounts payable and receivable, and drive timely, accurate month-end and year-end closes together with our tax advisory team.

 

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, accounting/controlling, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure.

  • Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions.

  • Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions.

  • Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning, DATEV and AI tooling a strong plus.

  • Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English.

  • Modern equipment setup for your needs to succeed

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8 p.m.

  • A team of 50+ (and growing) ambitious, diverse experts, 20%+ ex-founders, learning and building together

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales & Business Development (apeiron)
description: Werde Teil des Business Development Teams zur Förderung der neuen, innovativen apeiron-Plattform! Bei Ginmon arbeiten wir in einem Team aus jungen, visionären Experten daran, die Lücke zwischen wissenschaftlichem Portfoliomanagement und modernster Kapitalmarkttechnologie zu schließen. Mit unserer Plattform helfen wir Privatanleger:innen, ihre finanziellen Ziele durch ETF-basierte Anlagestrategien effizient und kostengünstig zu erreichen. Nach unserem Erfolg im B2C-Bereich markiert das Jahr 2026 einen Meilenstein: den offiziellen Start von apeiron Wealth ( www.apeiron-wealth.com ). Dabei handelt es sich um unser zukunftsweisendes, KI-natives Betriebssystem für Vermögensberater:innen, das eine hochmoderne, vollautomatisierte Infrastruktur bietet. Diese ermöglicht es Vermögensberater:innen, ihr gesamtes Beratungsgeschäft zu digitalisieren und die Qualität sowie die Tiefe der Kundenbetreuung erheblich zu steigern. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Business Development Team unterstützt du uns bei der Vermarktung des Produkts apeiron und der Generierung neuer Leads. Dabei sammelst du praxisnahe Einblicke in den Aufbau eines wachsenden B2B-Geschäfts. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für unser Produkt apeiron und dessen Marktvorteile, um potenzielle Kund:innen kompetent beraten zu können. Du initiierst den Erstkontakt zu unabhängigen Finanzberater:innen über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn) und vermittelst dabei einen professionellen und positiven Eindruck von apeiron. Du vereinbarst Termine mit unserem Business-Development-Manager und unserem CEO und hilfst mit, unsere Strategie zur Produktvermarktung mitzugestalten. Du pflegst und aktualisierst CRM-Datensätze sorgfältig, um eine datengestützte Sales-Pipeline zu gewährleisten. Du setzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude und Gemini sowie Prozessautomatisierung ein, um deine Arbeitsprozesse und die Effizienz im Business Development zu steigern. Du arbeitest in einem Team aus jungen, initiativen Menschen und bist dem Business Development Manager sowie dem CEO unterstellt. Dabei erwarten dich Perspektiven zur eigenständigen Übernahme von Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereichen, die dir helfen, dich zum Business Development Manager weiterzuentwickeln. Dein Profil Du bist in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Finanzen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit Schwerpunkt Kapitalmarkt, eingeschrieben und hast idealerweise noch mindestens ein Jahr Studium vor dir. Du bist kontaktfreudig, kommunikationsstark und trittst auch am Telefon sicher und professionell auf. Idealerweise bringst du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, im Vertrieb oder in der Beratung mit. Du begeisterst dich für innovative technologische Lösungen und KI und möchtest Arbeitsprozesse durch intelligente Tools maximal effizient gestalten. Du bist ein echter Teamplayer, kannst aber ebenso eigenständig agieren. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Leads und denkst proaktiv mit. Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (wichtig für die Kundenansprache) und verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse. Du wohnst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und arbeitest flexibel 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main. Was wir bieten Die Möglichkeit, den Markterfolg von apeiron Wealth aktiv mitzugestalten und die digitale Transformation der deutschen Vermögensberatung direkt zu beeinflussen. Maßgebliche Möglichkeiten zum Weiterlernen durch Workshops mit erfahrenen Professionals sowie gezielten Kompetenzaufbau. Direktes Reporting an den Business Development Manager und den CEO sowie flache Hierarchien mit viel Raum für deine eigenen Ideen, perfekt, um wertvolle Business- und Vertriebserfahrung direkt vom Management zu sammeln. Ein internationales, junges und gleichgesinntes Team von Profis mit einer ausgeprägten "Get-things-done"-Mentalität und einer hervorragenden Arbeitsatmosphäre. Eine ausgewogene Balance zwischen Klausurenphase und Job dank flexibler Einteilung deiner 16 bis 20 Stunden. Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments, High-End-Equipment (auch für dein Studium nutzbar), regelmäßige Teamevents sowie eine moderne Büroatmosphäre inklusive Kaffeeflatrate, Snacks und Drinks. title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
description: Your mission IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte. Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität. Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife. Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb. Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden. Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance. Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch. Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten. Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk. Your profile Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität. Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung der Umsetzung komplexer Infrastruktur-, Bau-, Energie-, Mobilitäts-, Telekommunikations- oder vergleichbarer Rollout-Programme über mehrere Standorte hinweg, ideralerweise im Bereich HPC Ladeinfrastruktur. Du kannst eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Übernahme von Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Umsetzungslebenszyklus vorweisen – und nicht nur für einzelne Projektaufgaben oder Arbeitspakete. Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in Programm- und Projektsteuerung, einschließlich integrierter Planung, Risikomanagement, Abhängigkeitsmanagement, Änderungssteuerung und Reporting auf Senior-Ebene. Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner sowie in der Einflussnahme auf interne Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation. Du trittst sicher auf, stellst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv infrage, triffst Entscheidungen und eskalierst Themen, wenn dies erforderlich ist. Du verfügst über ein fundiertes praktisches Verständnis der Schnittstellen zwischen Standortentwicklung, Genehmigungsplanung, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb. Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und bist bereit, regelmäßig mit Teams an den Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten. Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien oder anderer dezentraler, kundenorientierter Infrastruktur. Du verfügst über etablierte Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern und Baupartnern in einem oder mehreren DACH-Märkten. Du hast Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen zu Hochspannungs- oder elektrotechnischer Infrastruktur sowie mit der Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in ein operatives Netzwerk. Du verfügst über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in AutoCAD und Microsoft Office, einschließlich fortgeschrittener Excel-Kenntnisse oder vergleichbarer Projektsteuerungs-Tools. Du hast ein einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, eine technische Qualifikation oder vergleichbare berufliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Bauwesen, Infrastruktur oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet. title: Senior Software Engineer – IT Risk & Pricing (m/f/d)
description: Your new team: As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. What you can expect: Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability. Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions. Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards. Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development. Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues. Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges. Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support. Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness. Your profile Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python. System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs. SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features. Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued. Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage. Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards. Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes. Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture. Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle. Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English. What we offer: Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation. Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace. Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility. Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals. Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed. Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility. Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance. Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us. Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle. For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process. Ownership: Du priorisierst Maßnahmen eigenständig, setzt sie um und bewertest ihre Wirkung kontinuierlich. Marktverständnis: Du verfolgst die Entwicklung von Suchmaschinen und KI-getriebenen Suchsystemen und leitest daraus konkrete Empfehlungen ab. Sprachlevel: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut auf Englisch (B2). Das bringen wir mit: Flexibilität für Deine Lebensgestaltung : Genieße familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten und eine großzügige Homeoffice-Regelung , damit Du in jeder Lebenslage agil und flexibel bleiben kannst. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten : Durch kurze Entscheidungswege ermöglichen wir Dir, selbstständig zu arbeiten und Deine Ideen aktiv einzubringen – bei uns hast Du Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Wachse mit uns : Entfalte Dein Potenzial mit zahlreichen Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einem jährlichen Entwicklungsbudget , um Deine fachlichen und persönlichen Ziele zu erreichen. Tagtäglich kommunizierst Du via Telefon oder E-Mail und stellst per Fernwartung sicher, dass unsere Kund:innen und Partner:innen reibungslos mit unserer Software arbeiten können.

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Mercanis bist du der zentrale Umsatztreiber für unser bestehendes Kundenportfolio im gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise-Segment. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Vertriebs-Restrukturierung trennen wir "Hunting" und "Farming" konsequent: Du übernimmst die volle Vertriebs- und Deal-Verantwortung für ein exklusives Territory von ca. 60–70 bestehenden Accounts. Deine Mission: Du identifizierst ungenutzte Cross- und Upsell-Potenziale, navigierst souverän durch komplexe C-Level-Buying-Center, steuerst vielschichtige Deal-Zyklen bis zum Verhandlungsabschluss und maximierst so nachhaltig unsere Net Revenue Retention (NRR). Wenn du ein tiefes Verständnis für B2B-SaaS-Vertriebsmethodiken mitbringst und Bestandskunden nicht nur betreuen, sondern durch echten Mehrwert strategisch ausbauen willst, ist dies deine perfekte Gelegenheit. Dein Aufgabenbereich Expansion & ARR-Wachstum: Du steuerst den gesamten Verkaufszyklus für Upsell-, Cross-Sell- und Modul-Erweiterungen in einem Portfolio von ca. 60–70 Bestandskunden und triffst deine eigenen Quota-Ziele. Pipeline-Generierung im Bestand: Du analysierst deine Accounts eigenständig auf White Spots, identifizierst neue Anwendungsfälle im Bereich Einkauf & Supply Chain Management und generierst aktiv qualifizierte Expansion-Pipeline. Strategisches Closing & C-Level Selling: Du navigierst komplexe Buying Center (CPO, CFO, IT-Leitung), baust Belieber- & Champion-Netzwerke auf Executive-Ebene auf und führst kommerzielle Verhandlungen (Preisgestaltung, Lizenzerweiterungen, Vertragsverlängerungen) eigenständig zum Abschluss. Executive Relationship & Account Planning: Du erstellst strategische Account-Pläne für deine Top-Kunden, führst regelmäßige Business Reviews (QBRs) auf C-Level durch und positionierst Mercanis als unverzichtbaren Software-Partner. Vorhersagbarkeit & Deal Execution: Du steuerst deine Deals anhand etablierter B2B-Sales-Methodiken (z. B. MEDDPICC), pflegst deine Pipeline im CRM mit hoher Forecasting-Genauigkeit und arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Success Team zusammen. Dein Profil B2B SaaS Closing-Erfahrung: Du bringst nachweisbare Erfolge im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb (als Account Executive, Enterprise AM oder Senior Closing Role) mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von Procurement-, SCM- oder komplexen B2B-Enterprise-Lösungen. Track Record in Deal Execution: Du hast eine nachweisliche Historie im Erreichen oder Übertreffen deiner Umsatzziele (Quota) und bist vertraut mit komplexen Verkaufszyklen und mehrstufigen Decision-Making-Prozessen. Sales Methodik & Value Selling: Du beherrschst Value-Based Selling, kannst ROI-Analysen auf C-Level überzeugend präsentieren und bist geübt im Umgang mit Sales-Frameworks (z. B. MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger). Verhandlungssicherheit & C-Level-Flüssigkeit: Du verhandelst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau oder seit mindestens 10 Jahren im deutschen Geschäftsumfeld verankert) sowie verhandlungssicher auf Englisch. Präsenz & Skalierungs-Drive: Du wohnst in Berlin (oder bist umzugsbereit) für unser Office-First/Hybrid-Modell, arbeitest datengetrieben und bringst die Motivation mit, in einem schnell skalierenden Tech-Startup Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Warum wir? Mentoring & persönliches Wachstum: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Seriengründern zusammen, die dich in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung aktiv begleiten und fördern. Compensation: Kompetitives Fixgehalt + attraktiver, ungedeckelter Bonus & VSOP (Beteiligungsmodell). Perks: Lebe das Scale-up-Life, regelmäßige Team Events & Offsites, und natürlich: kostenlose Uber-Eats-Meals & Uber-Rides, wenn’s mal wieder länger dauert. Room for Ideas: Wir leben eine offene Kultur mit echtem Sparring, du übernimmst Verantwortung und bekommst den Freiraum, deine Ideen voranzutreiben. Team Mindset: Werde Teil eines neugierigen, motivierten Teams, das mutig experimentiert, offen kommuniziert und sich stetig weiterentwickelt, gemeinsam und individuell. Central Location: Unser Büro liegt im Herzen von Berlins Startup-Ökosystem, mit bester Anbindung, großartiger Energie und tollen Menschen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
description: Welcome to baramundi! “Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.” Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner. At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features. Do what you do best: DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner. TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input. DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features. BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams. COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development. USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback. What we appreciate about you: Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment. Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers. Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working. Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures. Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements. Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality. Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders. Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.   • Integrate new internal and external applications into our identity infrastructure (e.g., SSO) following best practices
  • Work on projects to improve internal role-based access control concepts
  • Consult other teams and guide them to success, leveraging our services especially regarding identity and access management

  • Automate recurring tasks
  • Design the future IT infrastructure of Flix

About You

  • At least 3 years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID or similar identity and access management platforms
  • Advanced knowledge of modern authentication protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and SAML)
  • At least 3 years of scripting experience (ideally with Python)
  • At least 1 year of experience with IaC solutions (preferably Terraform)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to streamline infrastructure automation, troubleshooting, and daily operations
  • Basic experience using APIs
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus
  • Experience working with IaaS solutions is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React) or web technologies is a plus
  • Experience with M365 products (such as Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams) is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data. As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI. We are looking for a Mid-Level Security Engineer to own the hands-on engineering and operational work within our security program. You will act as a security enabler across all Product & Engineering. Investigate reported vulnerabilities at the code level, including our Rust core, Go and Python tooling. Partner with engineering teams to design, review, and verify fixes, and set clear security requirements on changes where the risk warrants it. Harden and maintain our GitHub organization’s security posture, including secret scanning, push protection, branch protection and rulesets, dependency alerts, and code scanning, in partnership with the engineering teams that use these repositories daily. Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and related infrastructure. Track and report security metrics (vulnerability remediation SLAs, MTTR, patch latency, critical findings) and keep reporting current for the Security Officer. Maintain clear, complete, and auditable records of vulnerability and incident work in our tracking systems. Build security automation and guardrails that scale across the development lifecycle: CI/CD security checks, policy-as-code, GitHub automation, and automated cloud security controls, so secure defaults are enforced by tooling rather than review. Participate in threat modeling and architecture reviews for new services and major changes. We are also building out our ISMS, which creates opportunities to contribute to security-tooling evaluations, technical vendor assessments, and proof-of-concept work. Formal compliance ownership, vendor risk assessments, and customer security questionnaires remain with the Security Officer. On-call expectations are low: there is no formal rotation, though occasional availability for high-severity incidents is expected. You write and maintain automation and security tooling comfortably, and can hold a credible technical conversation in code review. Experience triaging vulnerability reports or working with a bug bounty program, vulnerability disclosure program, product security team, or similar function. Practical knowledge of cloud and container security, particularly AWS and Kubernetes. Familiarity with GitHub security features and securing CI/CD pipelines. The ability to investigate alerts and vulnerabilities methodically, distinguish genuine risk from noise, and recommend proportionate remediation. Clear written communication skills for working with external researchers and internal engineering teams. A self-directed approach and comfort independently managing a security queue. 3+ years in a hands-on security engineering, product security, or vulnerability management role. Nice to have An offensive security background, such as penetration testing, CTF participation, vulnerability research, or exploit analysis. Experience working in an open-source company or contributing security improvements to open-source projects. Familiarity with cloud-native incident response. title: Working Student International Energy Advisory (m/w/d)
description: Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt Gebäude müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es Transparenz, messbare Daten und intelligente Lösungen. Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der ersten strategischen Idee über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen und gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Energieversorgung von morgen zu gestalten, suchen wir dich als Working Student im Projektmanagement (m/w/d) für unser Team Energy International in Frankfurt am Main . Deine Aufgaben In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung und arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team an Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem: Du unterstützt das Projektmanagement International bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Konzepte zur Kostenoptimierung sowie Effizienzsteigerung im Energieverbrauch. Im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit wirkst Du bei der Analyse, Aufbereitung und Auswertung projektrelevanter Daten mit und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Entscheidungsfindung. Du unterstützt das Team im operativen Projektmanagement-Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst dabei organisatorische und koordinative Aufgaben. Zudem begleitest du Ausschreibungsprozesse sowie Bietergespräche und unterstützt bei der Kommunikation mit externen Partnern, insbesondere internationale Energieversorgern. Die Vorbereitung und Strukturierung von Vertragsunterlagen für Verhandlungen gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich. Darüber hinaus erstellst du Präsentationen zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und wirkst bei der Aufbereitung von Ergebnissen für interne und externe Stakeholder mit. Das bringst du mit Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium an einer Fach- oder Hochschule – vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Energiewirtschaft oder BWL. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Projektmanagement oder in der Energie- bzw. Immobilienwirtschaft gesammelt. Du zeichnest dich durch lösungsorientiertes, analytisches und strukturiertes Denken und Handeln aus. Teamfähigkeit und Einsatzbereitschaft gehören ebenso zu deinen Stärken wie ein professionelles und sicheres Auftreten. Du verfügst über gute Grundkenntnisse in MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere in Excel. So arbeiten wir Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen zusammen und erhältst Einblicke in spannende Projekte und Themen rund um die Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberatung. Dabei kannst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium einbringen, praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln. Damit dies gelingt, bieten wir dir die entsprechenden Rahmenbedingungen: Wir bieten dir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du dich gut einfinden und konzentriert arbeiten kannst – mit moderner Ausstattung, guter Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr sowie Getränken, Snacks und frischem Obst. Bei Werkstudententätigkeiten richten wir uns nach deinem Studium: Während des Semesters kannst du uns bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen, in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit nach Absprache auch in Vollzeit. Praktika absolvierst du bei uns in Vollzeit. Dein nächster Schritt Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mit dir darüber zu sprechen, wie dein nächster beruflicher Schritt aussehen soll – und ob wir der richtige Partner dafür sind. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. The AI Customer Success function is being built from the ground up, and this role will help define it internationally. As the first Customer Success Manager in this area, you will own the end-to-end post-sale experience for a portfolio of customers that includes some of the world’s most sophisticated cyber threat intelligence teams and investigators, national security agencies, and financial crime teams. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts—you will help establish the playbook, define what success looks like, and drive a product-led growth motion that turns new customers into long-term, expanding partners. The impact you will have: Build and ship a v1 onboarding playbook within the first 30 days—a practical, working version built from early customer engagements that can be iterated as you learn what drives adoption across international customer segments. Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts—compressing hours of reporting preparation into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment. Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio—hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics—and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made. Identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play within 60 days by working backwards from expansion targets, focusing on the one or two use cases most likely to drive consumption across the customer base. Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at government agencies and financial institutions internationally—building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner. Partner with ADs on expansion plays, co-own NRR targets, and build the structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract. Close the feedback loop between customers and Product—synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use-case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap. Design the CS infrastructure and tooling stack that scales as the product grows—you are building the foundation the next CSM hire will inherit. What we're looking for: Background in cyber or cyber threat intelligence, intelligence agencies, financial crime investigations, or regulatory and compliance environments. 5+ years as an onboarding engineer, customer success manager, deployment strategist, or in another post-sale role with proven ownership of NRR, GRR, and expansion metrics—you have the track record, not just the title. Domain credibility in cyber, national security, or financial crime—you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth. Demonstrated zero-to-one builder experience—you have built a CS function, onboarding playbook, or PLG motion from scratch and can point to the specific outcomes it drove. Production AI fluency—you have built real, repeatable AI workflows, not just experiments, that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and deliver measurable results. You can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop. A high level of independence—you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers. Strong executive presence—you can run a QBR with a senior government stakeholder or financial institution executive and command the room through substance, not just polish. Experience supporting international customers, with the ability to navigate regional, cultural, and time-zone differences. About the Team: This team focuses on TRM’s AI-driven Intel platform, supporting investigators and cyber teams working on complex cases involving cyber threats. This is the first Customer Success hire dedicated to international customers—you will help build the function from the ground up, with high autonomy, direct access to leadership, and meaningful influence on how TRM approaches customer success globally. The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant—async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions. You will work directly with the Head of Customer Success and Patrick South, CRO, with close day-to-day collaboration with international Sales teams and Product. Team Operating Rhythms: As a globally distributed team, members work across multiple time zones. This role will primarily align its working hours and customer coverage with international markets, with flexibility to collaborate across regions when needed. Our Customer Success team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly customer syncs, biweekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with customers across international markets. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team. The team moves fast and iterates—v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific. On-Call Responsibilities: End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success across international markets. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within 30 days of joining, you ship a working v1 onboarding playbook built from your first 2–3 accounts—not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations. Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success-metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction—getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook. Within 60 days, you identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play by working backwards from expansion targets—presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on which use case to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data from international customers. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered. What to Expect From Our Interview Process Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact. Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions. Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding. Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. Learn more about interviewing at TRM Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders . Privacy Policy and Additional Information By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy . We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM. Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law. If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form . Recruitment agencies TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement. title: Senior AI Product Designer  (m/w/d)
description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe. What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet. You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones. You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production. You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on. You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against. You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary. You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships. You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it. How we design: We're AI-native. We use AI tools daily in our own process, not just in what we design, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well. Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators. Human-in-the-loop by default. This is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and verification moments that make that real, not just a confidence score bolted on. We ship in production, not just in Figma. Craft is judged by what clinicians actually use, so we stay close to what ships. What to expect as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d): Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals. Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you. Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement. Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs. Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off. Here's how we picture you as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d): You have 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years operating at Senior, Principal, or Staff altitude. You have designed for AI and non-determinism before, and can talk concretely about how you've communicated agent behaviour, handled errors, and kept users in control, not just in the abstract. You have owned or significantly contributed to a design system, at the level of patterns and principles rather than individual components. You are block-shaped: equally strong across UX process, UI craft, product thinking, research, storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration. You have taken features from 0 to 1 through an ambiguous problem statement to shipped code, and you're comfortable feeling like a PM or frontend developer on the days that calls for it. You have high agency and spot gaps without being asked to look for them, including outside your own product area. You hold a position under pressure but change it when new information warrants, rather than becoming precious about your own decisions. You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable operating in an international environment; German is a plus but not required. You bring a consumer-grade craft background with exceptional design; healthtech experience is a plus but not required. If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

IT'S A MATCH, SOFERN DU... eingeschrieben bist und dich mindestens im dritten Semester deines Studiums befindest – beispielsweise in BWL mit Schwerpunkt Personal, Personalmanagement, (Wirtschafts-)Psychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. unser Team mit 16–20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen kannst und dich auf die Zusammenarbeit in unserem Frankfurter Büro und im Homeoffice freust. motiviert und lernbereit bist und dich schnell in spannende, verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben einarbeiten möchtest oder idealerweise schon erste Erfahrung in HR, Recruiting oder Employer Branding gesammelt hast. ein Organisationstalent bist, ein Händchen für kreative Recruitingideen hast und du Lust hast, dich mit dem Thema Employer Branding zu beschäftigen und unsere Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken. eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mitbringst und du dich selbst zugänglich und empathisch beschreibst. sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen bist und gerne digital arbeitest. sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst. WAS WIR DIR BIETEN Teamspirit, den man erlebt: Offene Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und regelmäßige Teamevents sind bei uns fest verankert. Ob Team-Lunch, Afterwork-Drinks oder gemeinsame Aktivitäten – wir nehmen uns bewusst Zeit füreinander.  Arbeitszeiten, die zu dir passen: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und abgestimmten Präsenzzeiten gestalten wir gemeinsam eine gute Balance zwischen Studium und Job.  Gestalte mit und wachse in Verantwortung hinein: Bei uns bekommst du die Unterstützung, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dich weiterzuentwickeln und wertvolle Praxiserfahrung zu sammeln.  Unsere Werte – gelebter Alltag: Teamgeist, Professionalität und Leidenschaft prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, übernehmen Verantwortung und wachsen gemeinsam.  Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts: Unser zentral gelegenes Büro mit moderner Ausstattung bietet dir Raum für kreative Ideen, konzentriertes Arbeiten und entspanntes Abschalten. raw.title: (Senior) Sustainability Manager
raw.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a (Senior) Sustainability Manager in our Product Management team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our Sustainability Cockpit. Working at the intersection of product, regulation, and customer needs, you will drive the continued development of solutions supporting organisations in meeting evolving sustainability reporting requirements.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to translate regulatory developments and customer feedback into valuable product capabilities. If you enjoy combining sustainability expertise with product thinking and want to help customers navigate an evolving ESG landscape, we'd love to hear from you.

EQS Group is a leading international cloud software provider in the areas of Compliance & Ethics, Data Privacy, Sustainability Management, and Investor Relations. We help thousands of companies worldwide to cultivate trust by simplifying complex processes, ensuring transparency, and enabling clear communication with stakeholders.

Our success is built on our people. We bring together talented individuals who care about doing meaningful work, take pride in what they do, and support one another to achieve more together. We believe passion and trust aren’t just values — they’re at the core of how we operate, every day.

Our mission is to Create Trusted Companies. If you share our passion for our mission, we’d love to have you help us turn it into reality.


OUR CULTURE DRIVES OUR BENEFITS

  • You're important. We foster a trusting environment and lifelong learning to support your individual development. Set personal development goals, receive support and regular feedback — we give you the tools to succeed.
  • Living our values. Our values connect us. They shape how we work and collaborate across teams and cultures, creating belonging, trust, and an environment where everyone can thrive.
  • Great atmosphere. We cultivate a dynamic culture where shared goals bring us together. From unforgettable company events to volunteering initiatives, we inspire and empower each other to make a positive impact.
  • Work-life balance is a must. Enjoy a modern office with state-of-the-art equipment, flexible working hours, and a hybrid model — including the ability to work from abroad within the EU. Paid vacation is standard, and for longer breaks, we offer a sabbatical because your free time matters too.
  • Special perks just for you. We offer you other exciting benefits, such as salary optimization in the form of customized bonus and benefit programs, as well as corporate shopping benefits.
  • Health is a priority. We support your well-being with company-sponsored sports programs for the use of various fitness studios, bicycle leasing via JobRad, and mental health counseling.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the further development of the EQS Sustainability Cockpit with a particular focus on CSRD, EU Taxonomy, and sustainability reporting capabilities.
  • Translate regulatory developments and market requirements into clear product priorities and requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success Management (CSM), Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver customer-centric product enhancements.
  • Act as a sustainability subject matter expert for internal stakeholders, particularly Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Participate in Sales and customer meetings to answer domain-specific questions and guide prospects and customers in navigating sustainability reporting requirements.
  • Gather and evaluate customer and market feedback to continuously improve the Sustainability Cockpit.
  • Monitor developments in the European sustainability reporting landscape and assess their impact on the product roadmap.
Be part of an exciting journey and contribute to our success story of becoming the leading provider of digital compliance and governance solutions.


THIS IS YOU

Must have

  • Professional experience in sustainability, ESG reporting, or sustainable finance, ideally within a software or technology environment.
  • Strong knowledge of CSRD, EU Taxonomy, and the European sustainability reporting landscape, complemented by knowledge of additional reporting frameworks or emerging regulatory developments.
  • Experience working with cross-functional product development and customer-facing teams, supported by strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into structured product requirements.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in German (C2) and English (C1).
  • Experience with ESG or sustainability reporting software.
  • Practical experience using AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and AI-enabled workflow automation to make sustainability research, regulatory analysis, and product documentation more efficient, with a responsible approach to data privacy and output quality.
  • Experience supporting customer conversations, product demonstrations, or go-to-market initiatives.
Nice to have
  • Familiarity with agile product development methodologies.

We are open to hiring remotely in Germany.

Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.</p></div><div class="row"> <div class="col-12 col-lg-8 col-xl-7 col-xxl-5">&nbsp;</div> </div> <h3>A personal note from Andreea, Global Head of HR</h3> <p>I'm Andreea, Global Head of HR at OPSWAT.&nbsp;OPSWAT is also the kind of place where opportunities tend to find the people willing to take them on. Things move fast, there’s always something new to figure out, and you get a lot of space to make an impact.&nbsp;For me, HR works best when it can move at the pace of the business — close enough to understand what’s really going on and quick enough to make a difference.&nbsp;I don’t see that as a formula, though. I’d love to shape what it looks like together with someone who shares that mindset, but who will also bring their own perspective and challenge my thinking along the way. title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Paid Social)
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Direct Acquisition team at iwoca is responsible for acquiring customers profitably across paid and organic channels. Paid Social is one of our highest-growth channels; we've validated the opportunity, proven incrementality, and scaled from test budgets to six-figure monthly spend across Meta and TikTok. Now we need to build on those foundations and scale toward a 3x growth ambition across a multi-product offering that includes both flexi-loans and credit cards. You'll join a team that: Takes measurement seriously: We run conversion lift studies, work closely with data science on attribution, and make budget decisions based on predicted and incremental ROI, not vanity metrics. Cares deeply about creative: We believe the ad is the targeting, and we're building a creative engine that spans creator partnerships, UGC, and AI-assisted production. Is genuinely AI-native: We use AI tools daily for analysis, creative development, and workflow automation, and we expect you to do the same. The role Paid Social at iwoca is working; we've proven the channel's incremental value, scaled to six-figure monthly spend, and built the measurement infrastructure to back it up. But there's a lot more to go after with a credit card to bring to market, a creative engine to build, and a lot of room still to scale. The remit is broad - you'll scale the channel, bring our credit card to market and grow it aggressively alongside our core lending product. You'll invest heavily in creative - particularly video and influencer marketing - building ads that actually cut through in a category where most ads look the same. Key responsibilities include: Strategy & Campaign Architecture Own Paid Social as a channel: set the vision, define the road map, allocate budget, and report on performance to leadership. Bring our credit card product to market through paid social: build the campaign strategy, creative approach, and measurement framework for a major product launch. Architect full-funnel structures across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn - awareness, prospecting, lead capture, re-targeting, and conversion - with clear success metrics, audience hand-offs, and frequency management at each stage. Manage multi-product overlap: flexi-loans, credit cards, and other products share audiences but serve different customer needs. Expand audience reach through content-led lead capture campaigns targeting out-of-market prospects to fuel top-of-funnel growth. Scale into new platforms where there's genuine opportunity; we’ve validated a significant opportunity on TikTok, but other platforms such as Linkedin and Youtube Shorts remain largely untapped. Creative Strategy & Production Develop creative that actually stands out: paid social in financial services is full of generic stock imagery and safe messaging. We want you to push beyond that, finding the concepts, formats, and creators that people actually notice. Make a significant investment in video and influencer marketing: build relationships with creators who can speak authentically about business finance, and develop a pipeline that delivers volume without it becoming generic. Build a testing framework that connects creative concepts to commercial outcomes Partner with the Brand team to make sure performance and brand creative reinforce each other rather than pulling in different directions. Measurement & Incrementality Design, run, and turn conversion lift studies and geo-lift tests into investment cases that prove incremental value and justify budget expansion. Partner with Data Science and the Acquitech team on attribution methodology, event architecture, and multi-step conversion tracking. Extend testing beyond ad platforms to landing page experiments and signup flow improvements to reduce drop-off between click and conversion. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Manage and develop a Performance Marketing Executive, coaching them on strategic thinking and commercial analysis while delegating clear operational ownership. Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Compliance, and Brand teams, while getting genuine strategic value from Meta and TikTok platform reps. The requirements Mechanically curious: You understand why platforms work the way they do, stay updated on algorithmic changes, and have an industry network for shared learning. High-initiative: You define experiments, draft business cases, and drive projects forward without waiting for explicit briefs. Analytically self-sufficient: You pull your own data, build your own performance views, and think in terms of CLTV, ROI, and marginal returns. AI-native: You already use AI tools meaningfully in your work - whether for creative analysis, reporting, workflow automation, or something we haven't thought of. Commercially minded: You care about profitable customer acquisition and lifetime value. What You Bring: Proven track record of scaling paid social budgets based on measured commercial performance. Deep campaign architecture expertise on Meta (bidding strategies, audience signals, and creative interaction). Experience with multi-product, multi-market and value-based bidding models. Strategic creative capability connecting concepts to commercial hypotheses. Nice to Have: B2B paid social experience (or strong analytical background in B2C). Experience managing or coaching junior team members. Fluency in measurement and incrementality (conversion lift studies, holdout methodologies, and incremental value). Hands-on experience with TikTok advertising at scale. Fintech or financial services background. The compensation £70,000 - £90,000 (bench marked regularly with quarterly performance reviews). The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We're looking for a Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting to join our team remotely! The #1 goal of this role is to turn complex compliance and regulatory data into clear, actionable insights that protect the business, satisfy regulators, and support senior leadership in making high-stakes decisions. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, regulatory reporting, and compliance operations in a fast-paced, high-scrutiny environment where accuracy and audit-readiness are non-negotiable.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with deep knowledge of compliance regulations and frameworks. You'll own end-to-end data management from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and insights for compliance and leadership teams. You will also automate compliance processes and workflows to boost efficiency and minimize human error.

If you combine exceptional data analysis expertise with solid knowledge of compliance regulations, a keen eye for regulatory risk, and the drive to shape the future of crypto with a top-tier brand - this is your next mission!

 

The opportunity

  • Own the design of dashboards, compliance metrics, and regulatory reports, turning data into actionable insights for stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and regional compliance officers

  • Automate end to end compliance related data solutions, governance controls, and automations to boost efficiency and minimize manual intervention

  • Dive into large, complex datasets to turn findings into scalable, audit-ready data models that facilitate regulatory reporting and analytics

  • Translate regulatory and business requests into accurate reports and automated data pipelines using Python, SQL, DBT and Airflow

  • Lead cross-functional projects with analysts, engineers, and compliance teams to build and maintain high-quality data pipelines and sources

  • Coordinate client data quality monitoring by identifying issues, flagging remediations, and partnering with responsible teams to ensure timely resolution

  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs

  • Deliver insights that shape compliance direction through clear, data-driven storytelling

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, with hands-on experience in compliance and regulatory reporting across frameworks such as AML, KYC, Sanctions, MiCA, or MiFID

  • Solid understanding of regulatory risk and the ability to operate effectively in high-scrutiny, audit-ready environments

  • Expert SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, and analytical functions, paired with proficiency in Python libraries such as pandas, matplotlib, and plotly

  • Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

  • Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of data workflow orchestration

  • Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, or Superset to build executive-facing dashboards

  • Strong communicator who can simplify complex data ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Alignment with the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

 

Nice to haves

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related technical field

  • Passion for continuous learning and approaching problems with a beginner's mindset

  • Solid understanding of the cryptocurrency space and how financial markets function
